map.按半衰期 5 小时，体内残留降至 25 mg 以下约需 4–5 个半衰期（20–: With a half-life of 5 hours it takes about 4-5 half-lives (20-25 h) for the residual amount to fall below 25 mg, but what disturbs sleep is mainly the high concentration during the 6-8 h before bed. Caffeine-sensitive people are advised to stop intake in the afternoon (after 14:00).
